title: 第2章 红花楼
content_zh:
第2章红花楼
镇远镖局门口出现骚乱之时，不远处的布庄二楼就有所察觉，一名美艳女子从书桌后起身，来到窗口打量。
女子身着齐腰襦裙，上身暗红交领衫衣，包裹着沉甸甸的胸襟，腰衱恰到好处束住腰儿，坠有压裙碧珠，裙子则是淡白褶裙；双眸如杏，唇上点着朱红胭脂，配上知性的气质，美艳不失稳重成熟。
瞧见上门挑事儿的夜惊堂，女子未曾动怒，媚意天成的杏眸，反而亮了下：
“骨重神寒天庙器，亦狂亦侠亦温文……好标致的相貌。”
背后的丫鬟，踮起脚尖遥遥打量：“是啊，真俊，就是看起来脑子不好使，踢馆也不摸摸背景。要不要打声招呼，免得陈彪出手太重……”
一声轻响后，陈彪被按住，街面陷入寂静，也让两个女子哑然。
“家父裴远峰……”
清朗嗓音传来，美艳女子眼神从看帅哥的轻佻，瞬间化为了正视，继而又显了‘久旱逢甘露’的炽热。
不过这种反应，并非美艳女子对夜惊堂动了不轨之心。
女子被称为‘裴三娘’，本名裴湘君，看打扮像是寻常商贾之家的女眷，但这美艳温柔的表象下，却还有另一层身份——江湖豪门红花楼当代掌舵之人！
大魏王朝立国不过甲子，如今女帝临朝，北有强敌虎视眈眈，内有诸王居心叵测，混乱大势，孕育出了一座空前繁盛的‘江湖’。
江湖上能雄镇一方者可称宗师，宗师顶端的‘一仙二圣八大魁’，为天下间最强十一人，连朝廷都需谨慎对待。
而红花楼上任掌舵人裴沧，便是八大魁中的‘枪魁’，位列‘天下第七’，红花楼的江湖地位可见一斑。
枪魁裴沧，是裴湘君的师父、裴远峰生父，算起来也是夜惊堂的干爷爷。
裴远峰本是裴家次子，自幼天赋惊人，但和家里有争执，离家出走，发誓不名扬天下不回头。
结果不言自明，裴远峰到死都没太大名声，不教夜惊堂真功夫，不是不愿，是不想让夜惊堂再重蹈覆辙。
裴远峰死后，让夜惊堂净身出户入京，并非对夜惊堂心性的考验，而是给家里的‘名帖’。
正常人都不会‘重情守信’到听一个死人的话，放弃家业当个无家可归的浪人。
但裴远峰知道夜惊堂会，他此举只是为了让家里看到这一点，以便夜惊堂能进入红花楼，成为下一任掌舵人和‘枪魁’——这才是裴远峰留给儿子的真正遗产。

不过裴远峰可能也没料到，裴家现在混的不比他好多少。
裴沧多年前就去世，长子继承位置，却死于敌手，‘枪魁’名号易主，只能由小徒弟裴湘君继任红花楼掌舵。
裴湘君是女儿身，武艺不低，但与‘八大魁’差距甚远，根本扛不起江湖顶流豪门的大梁，以至于‘主少国疑’，红花楼威望一落千丈。
外有江湖势力吞并财路，内有各大堂主夺权，裴湘君的位子早就坐不稳了，甚至派人暗中寻找过‘二爷’的下落，指望他能回来撑场面。
裴远峰已经入土为安，对裴家来说显然是个噩耗，但夜惊堂能‘回家’，已经算是给摇摇欲坠的裴家带来了一线生机——裴家现在实在太需要一位惊才绝艳的‘少主’，来当定海神针，压住红花楼的内忧外患！
也是因此，裴湘君发现夜惊堂身手不俗，又得知其身份后，才会露出这般‘如饥似渴’的神情。
眼见夜惊堂准备不辞而别，经过窗下，裴湘君推起了街边支窗，素手轻拨，把支杆给推了下去。
牵马从街上经过的夜惊堂，抬起头来，眼眸里显出依窗美人的倒影，但并未露出寻常男子一样的惊艳：
“姑娘怎么这般不小心？”
裴湘君容貌甚佳，极少有男子能在瞧见她时不动如山，见此不由暗暗点头，故作不悦道：
“没大没小，我叫裴湘君，是你义父的师妹，家里人都叫我三娘。你是二哥的儿子，回家了，怎么招呼不打就走？”
义父的师妹……
夜惊堂从义父的书信中，只知道义父家在京城，其他一无所知。
义父让他把家产全给裴家，他堂堂七尺男儿，把家业给了，自然不会再寄人篱下混饭吃。
但看起来好香的软饭……
那更不能吃！
夜惊堂弄明白裴湘君的身份后，抬手一礼：
“见过师姑。义父让我把东西送来，事情办完，还得去衙门换领符牌，等我在京中安顿下来，再来府上拜会。”
此言显然是婉拒，不想登门。
但站在夜惊堂肩膀上的大白鸟，可没这么客气。

听见是亲戚，鸟鸟很自来熟的飞上二楼窗口，停在裴湘君规模不俗的胸前，张开鸟喙：
“叽~”
这只毛发雪白的鸟鸟，是夜惊堂的猎鸟，取名为‘白王爷’——白嫖王的意思——按理说是一只鸟，但长成了一个球。
具体是什么品种，夜惊堂也不清楚，年少在家晒谷子时，这鸟跑来蹭吃蹭喝，被他逮住，就养着了。
本以为是什么‘山泽瑞兽’，但养了这么多年，发现这大胖鸡除了能吃能睡能卖萌外，并没有什么特殊之处，某些时候还爱犯蠢。
就比如现在，自作主张跑上去要饭，落在人家女子胸脯上也罢，小爪爪略微陷入酥软布料，估摸是觉得脚感不错，还来回踩了两下，眸子亮晶晶的，回头看向夜惊堂：
“叽~”
意思大概是——好软呀
此举把裴湘君弄得脸色一红，连忙把调皮鸟鸟抱下来：
“咦~这鸟真粘人~”
夜惊堂眼神尴尬，出言训道：
“回来。”
“叽……”
鸟鸟这才老实从二楼飞下来，落在了夜惊堂的肩膀上。
裴湘君捋了下衣襟，继续道：
“你还是直接叫我三娘吧，师姑显得年纪大。二哥也真是，收你为义子，却又让你把家业送来，裴家要是收了，准被街坊戳脊梁骨。你既然来了，咱们就是一家人，不用如此见外。银子你还是拿回去，以后你就是我裴家的少爷，外面那间镖局划给你经营，如何？”
夜惊堂变卖边关小城的镖局，得了一千多两银子，看似不多，但按照购买力换算，约莫就是前世的一百多万，对寻常人来说绝非小数目；而开在京城里面的一家镖局，价码起码翻十番。
大丈夫不吃嗟来之食，对于这种馈赠，夜惊堂直接谢绝：
“多谢三娘好意，但义父遗嘱如此安排，我就不会违逆。义父的亲朋便是我的亲朋，您以后若有所需，大可让杨镖头知会我一声。几位镖师都是家中老人，往后还望三娘善待，在下先告辞了。”
裴湘君见夜惊堂遵信守义，不愿无功受禄，心中愈发青睐，没有再强留，又客气两句后，便目送夜惊堂离去。

很快，一人一马一鸟，汇入街上人群，消失在街口。
裴湘君直至夜惊堂从视野中消失，笑意才慢慢收敛，化为了深思。
丫鬟秀荷站在背后，此时才冒头，小声道：
“楼主，二爷这是给咱们送了个宝贝疙瘩回来？夜少爷长得真俊俏，刚才看了我一眼，把我腿都看酥了……”
裴湘君双眸微眯，稍显不悦，但很快又点头：
“确实没想到，二哥能收这么俊个义子，看的我都心猿意马……就不说武艺品行，光靠这相貌，也能在京城混得风生水起。”
秀荷嘻嘻笑了下：“夜少爷天赋如何呀？楼主看出底细没有？”
裴湘君认真琢磨：“气息乱如杂藤，却有一身磅礴内劲；拳脚毫无章法，筋骨却不输龙虎。二哥应该只给他打了底子，没教真功夫。年仅十八岁有此等火候，可谓天纵奇才，只要有人肯教真功夫，短短几年在江湖打出名气不无可能。”
秀荷眼底露出一抹郑重：“那现在怎么办？找机会和夜少爷说楼里的事儿，传授枪法当少主培养？”
裴湘君微微摇头：“遵从遗嘱千里送家产，看起来品行极佳，但知人知面不知心。功夫是杀人技，不可轻传；红花楼盘子太大，未来楼主之选，也不能我一言定夺，还是得先观察一段时间。”
“可夜少爷看起来性格很硬，不愿寄人篱下住在裴家，怎么观察？”
“初入江湖的年轻人，都硬气。我晚上过去劝劝，就软了……”
“楼主。”
“嗯？”
“这话听起来怪怪的……”
content_en:
Chapter 2 Red Flower House
When there was a commotion at the entrance of Zhenyuan Escort Bureau, someone was noticed on the second floor of Buzhuang not far away. A beautiful woman got up from the desk and came to the window to take a look.
The woman wears a waist-length underskirt, a dark red cross-collar shirt, covering her heavy breasts, and the waist is just right. There are green beads hanging on the skirt, and the skirt is a pale white pleated skirt. Her eyes are like apricots, and her lips are dotted with vermilion rouge. With her intellectual temperament, she is beautiful but stable and mature.
Seeing Ye Jingtang coming to stir up trouble, the woman was not angry, but her charming almond eyes lit up:
"A weapon from the Hantian Temple of the God of Heavy Bones, he is also crazy, chivalrous and gentle... What a beautiful appearance."
The maid behind stood on tiptoes and looked at him from a distance: "Yes, he is really handsome, but he seems to have a hard time with his brain, and he doesn't touch the background even when he is playing. Do you want to say hello, so that Chen Biao doesn't strike too hard..."
After a soft sound, Chen Biao was held down, and the street fell into silence, leaving the two women speechless.
"My father, Pei Yuanfeng..."
The clear voice came, and the beautiful woman's eyes instantly changed from looking at the handsome guy with frivolity, to looking at him seriously, and then showed the fierceness of "the long drought brings sweet dew".
However, this reaction does not mean that the beautiful woman has evil intentions towards Ye Jingtang.
The woman was called ‘Pei Sanniang’, and her real name was Pei Xiangjun. She looked like she was a daughter of an ordinary merchant family, but beneath her beautiful and gentle appearance, there was another identity – the current helmsman of Honghua House, a wealthy family in the world!
The Wei Dynasty could not be established for more than a year. Now that the female emperor is coming to the throne, there are powerful enemies in the north, and there are kings with ulterior motives. The situation is chaotic and has given birth to an unprecedentedly prosperous "jianghu".
Those who can dominate one area in the world can be called a Grandmaster. The "One Immortal, Two Saints and Eight Great Leaders" at the top of the Grandmaster are the eleven most powerful people in the world, and even the imperial court must treat them with caution.
Pei Cang, the former helmsman of Honghua Tower, is the ‘gun leader’ among the eight leaders, ranking ‘seventh in the world’, which shows Honghua Tower’s status in the world.
Spear leader Pei Cang is Pei Xiangjun's master, Pei Yuanfeng's biological father, and he is also the godfather of Ye Jingtang.
Pei Yuanfeng was originally the second son of the Pei family. He had amazing talents since he was a child. However, he had a dispute with his family and ran away from home. He vowed not to look back until he became famous in the world.
The results are self-evident. Pei Yuanfeng did not have a great reputation until his death. He did not teach Ye Jingtang real kung fu, not because he was unwilling, but because he did not want Ye Jingtang to make the same mistakes again.
After Pei Yuanfeng died, asking Ye Jingtang to cleanse himself and go to Beijing was not a test of Ye Jingtang's character, but a 'name card' for the family.
Normal people would not be so "loving and trustworthy" that they would listen to a dead man and give up their family fortune to become a homeless wanderer.
But Pei Yuanfeng knew about the Night Terror Hall, and he did this just to let his family see this, so that the Night Terror Hall could enter the Red Flower House and become the next helmsman and 'gun leader' - this is the real legacy that Pei Yuanfeng left to his son.
However, Pei Yuanfeng may not have expected that the Pei family is not doing much better than him now.
Pei Cang passed away many years ago, and his eldest son inherited the position, but died at the hands of an enemy. The title of "Gun Leader" changed hands, and his young apprentice Pei Xiangjun could only succeed him at the helm of Honghua House.
Pei Xiangjun was born as a girl, and his martial arts skills were not low, but he was far from the "Eight Great Leaders" and could not carry the weight of the top wealthy families in the world. As a result, the prestige of Honghua Tower plummeted due to the "young master's doubts about the country".
With the gangster forces outside trying to annex the money, and the powerful leaders seizing power inside, Pei Xiangjun's position has long been unstable. He even sent people to secretly search for the whereabouts of the 'Second Master', hoping that he would come back to support the situation.
Pei Yuanfeng has been laid to rest, which is obviously bad news for the Pei family, but Ye Jingtang's return home has brought a glimmer of hope to the crumbling Pei family - the Pei family really needs a stunningly talented and beautiful 'young master' to act as a needle to suppress the internal and external troubles of Honghua House!
It was also because of this that Pei Xiangjun showed such a "hungry" expression after discovering that Ye Jingtang was very skilled and knowing his identity.Seeing Ye Jingtang preparing to leave without saying goodbye, Pei Xiangjun pushed up the street support window as he passed by the window, pushed down the support pole with his bare hands.
Ye Jingtang, who was leading his horse through the street, raised his head, and his eyes showed the reflection of the beauty in the window, but he did not show the same surprise as an ordinary man:
"Why is the girl so careless?"
Pei Xiangjun has a very beautiful appearance. Very few men can remain motionless when looking at her. Seeing this, he couldn't help but nod secretly and pretended to be displeased:
"No matter how old or young you are, my name is Pei Xiangjun. I am your adoptive father's junior sister. Everyone in my family calls me Sanniang. You are the second brother's son. Why did you leave without saying hello when you came home?"
My adoptive father’s junior sister...
From his adoptive father's letters, Ye Jingtang only knew that his adoptive father's home was in the capital, and he knew nothing else.
His adoptive father asked him to give all his family property to the Pei family. As a tall and dignified man, he gave the family property to him, so naturally he would no longer rely on others to earn a living.
But the soft rice looks delicious...
That’s even less edible!
After Ye Jingtang figured out Pei Xiangjun's identity, he raised his hand and saluted:
"I've met my sister-in-law. My adoptive father asked me to deliver the things. After the things are done, I have to go to the Yamen to exchange for the talisman. When I settle down in Beijing, I will come to visit you at my house."
This statement was obviously a polite refusal, not wanting to come to the door.
But the big white bird standing on Night Terror Hall's shoulder was not so polite.
Hearing that they were relatives, the bird flew up to the second floor window very familiarly, stopped on Pei Xiangjun's sizable chest, and opened its beak:
"Ji~"
This bird with snow-white fur is a hunting bird of Night Terror Hall. It is named 'White Prince' - meaning White Whore King - and is technically a bird, but it grows into a ball.
Ye Jingtang didn't know the specific species of it. When he was drying millet at home when he was young, this bird came to eat and drink. He caught it and kept it.
I thought it was some kind of 'Shanze auspicious beast', but after raising it for so many years, I found that this big fat chicken has nothing special except that it can eat, sleep and act cute. Sometimes it also likes to be stupid.
Just like now, I ran up to beg for food on my own initiative, and landed on a woman's breast. My little claws were slightly sunken into the soft fabric. I guess it felt good on my feet, so I stepped back and forth twice. With bright eyes, I looked back at the Night Terror Hall:
"Ji~"
It probably means - so soft
This move made Pei Xiangjun blush, and he quickly picked up the naughty bird:
"Hey~ this bird is so clingy~"
Ye Jingtang looked embarrassed and said:
"Come back."
"Ji..."
Only then did the bird fly down from the second floor and landed on Ye Jingtang's shoulder.
Pei Xiangjun smoothed his clothes and continued:
"You should just call me Sanniang. Sister, I look older. It's true that my second brother accepted you as his adopted son, but asked you to give away the family business. If the Pei family accepted it, they would be stabbed in the back by the neighbors. Since you are here, we are a family, and we don't need to be so open-minded. You should take the money back. From now on, you will be the young master of my Pei family, and the escort agency outside will be assigned to you to run, how about it?"
Ye Jingtang sold the escort bureau in the small border town and got more than a thousand taels of silver. It didn't seem like much, but according to the purchasing power, it was about one million in the previous life, which was by no means a small amount for ordinary people. The price of an escort bureau in the capital was at least ten times higher.
A true man does not eat food that comes from outside. For this kind of gift, Ye Jingtang directly declined:
"Thank you Sanniang for your kindness, but I will not disobey my adoptive father's will. My adoptive father's relatives and friends are my relatives and friends. If you need anything in the future, you can ask Head Guard Yang to inform me. Several of the escorts are old people in the family. I hope Sanniang will treat her well in the future, so I will take my leave now."
When Pei Xiangjun saw that Ye Jingtang abided by his word and did not want to receive salary for nothing, he became more and more favored in his heart and did not force him to stay. After saying a few polite words, he watched Ye Jingtang leave.
Soon, a man, a horse and a bird merged into the crowd on the street and disappeared at the corner of the street.
It wasn't until Ye Jingtang disappeared from sight that Pei Xiangjun's smile slowly faded and turned into deep thought..
The maid Xiuhe was standing behind, and then she came forward and whispered:
"Master, did the second master bring us a baby? Master Ye is so handsome. He just looked at me and made my legs go numb..."
Pei Xiangjun narrowed his eyes, slightly unhappy, but quickly nodded:
"I really didn't expect that my second brother could take in such a handsome adopted son. I'm so distraught when I see him... Not to mention his martial arts and character, he can prosper in the capital just by his looks."
Xiuhe chuckled: "How talented is Master Ye? Has the poster seen the truth?"
Pei Xiangjun thought carefully: "The aura is as messy as vines, but he has a majestic inner strength; his fists and feet are unorganized, but his muscles and bones are not inferior to dragons and tigers. The second brother probably only gave him a foundation and did not teach him real kung fu. He is only 18 years old and has such firepower, he can be called a genius. As long as someone is willing to teach real kung fu, it is possible to become famous in the world in just a few years."
There was a solemn look in Xiuhe's eyes: "Then what should we do now? Find an opportunity to talk to Master Ye about things in the building, and teach him marksmanship to train him as a young master?"
Pei Xiangjun shook his head slightly: "Following the will and sending the family property thousands of miles away seems to be of excellent character, but he knows people and faces but does not know the heart. Kung Fu is a killing skill and should not be taught lightly. The plate of Honghua House is too big. I cannot make a final decision on the future owner of the building. I have to observe it for a period of time."
"But Master Ye seems to have a very tough character and doesn't want to live under the supervision of others. How can we observe him?"
"Young people who are new to the world are very stubborn. I went there at night to persuade them, and they softened..."
"Owner."
"Huh?"
"This sounds weird..."
